stop_rules: Each trial uses one fresh owned source fixture and, only after verified recovery, one separately created follow-up fixture; preserve every failure and allow zero retries.
Source dispatch is one focused A chord with 2 s authority; never replay, regardless of source outcome.
If source action is not UNKNOWN with release unconfirmed, stop before recovery/followup and preserve result.
Verify exact producer absence before at most one public orphan recovery. Keep old action UNKNOWN, task_success null, replay denied.
Stop and retain fixture/fence on any target identity, foreground, recovery release, neutral readback, 2 s horizon, or fence uncertainty.
After recovery, require new Computer Use exact-window activation, expected-title HWND/PID foreground probe, fresh observation and fresh target generation before one distinct B action.
Only followup B may pass the independent task oracle; it must be tied to exact followup call/operation/generation and a char-B event within that dispatch interval, with fixture state ab.
Close fixture only after followup action release and task effect are independently verified; otherwise preserve it and report STOP.
No model/provider, efficiency, MAP01, general reliability, preview graduation, or original-action task-success claim.
Follow-up target must be a separately-created process/window with distinct HWND, PID, and generation; never reuse fenced source generation.
Freeze exactly five attempts; run once in order; any attempt failure or STOP ends the cohort without replacement.
The frozen source and follow-up window positions must match GetWindowRect receipts before any dispatch; mismatch stops before dispatch for source and before follow-up dispatch for the fresh target.
Each trial must start with the durable custody fence clear; preserve pending/uncertain fence and stop all later attempts.
